knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The wand has touched the eye area and cannot be verified as clean, so it is discarded.
Contact time is how long the item must stay wet with the disinfectant to work.
Reading the safety data sheet and stopping at irritation are the controls named in the lesson.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate select a single-use tool for an eye-area product
Assessor checks the cleaning and disinfection sequence for one reusable brush against the label contact time
Assessor checks the product register for open dates and expiry dates
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Safety data sheet for one eye-area product, with the control identified
stopWorkCriteria: A shared applicator is used on a second client
An expired or contaminated product is used
The candidate continues after a client reports eye irritation
